$schema: Setu Health design tokens · DTCG-style · values per theme

meta.name: Setu Health
meta.note: Every token has light / hc (high-contrast) / dark values. CSS variable name = "--" + path joined by "-" (see cssVar).

result-normal-fg.$description: Normal value — no fill, no flag

result-critical-row.$description: Row tint behind a critical value

sans.$value: "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans Bengali", "Hind Siliguri", system-ui, sans-serif
sans.$description: UI text; Bangla glyphs fall through to Noto Sans Bengali

mono.$value: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans Bengali", ui-monospace, monospace

stacks.$description: Script-aware stacks. Latin UI = IBM Plex Sans; Bangla = Noto Sans Bengali (primary) with Hind Siliguri fallback. Mixed strings render with --font-sans because Plex has no Bengali glyphs, so the browser falls through per-glyph.
stacks.googleFonts: IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600/700, IBM Plex Mono 400/500/600, Noto Sans Bengali 400/500/600/700, Hind Siliguri 400/500/600/700
stacks.rule: When the active language is bn, use lineHeightBn for every text style (Bangla conjuncts and matras need ~15–20% more leading).

lineHeightBn.$description: display line-height (Bangla — room for matra & conjuncts)

fontFeatureSettings.$description: Tabular lining figures for money, results, tables

digits.$description: User setting (numerals: bn | en) independent of UI language. IDs, tokens (A-017), barcodes, BMDC numbers and codes always stay Latin.

money.grouping: South Asian: last 3 digits, then groups of 2 (lakh, crore)
